name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea, telemetry model, or integration for this repository
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what problem you are trying to solve or what telemetry visibility is missing.

**Describe the proposed solution**
A clear and concise description of what you would like to see implemented.

**Component / Target Area**
Which area does this feature target?
- [ ] New Backend Integration (e.g. Go/Gin, NestJS, Ruby on Rails, Spring Boot)
- [ ] New Mobile / Web Client SDK (e.g. React Native, Swift iOS, Kotlin Android, Web JS)
- [ ] New dbt Analytics Mart (e.g. Cohort Retention, Churn Analysis, Customer LTV)
- [ ] New Grafana Cloud Dashboard / OpenMetrics Definitions
- [ ] Pipeline Optimization & Data Extraction Improvements
- [ ] Documentation, Guides & Examples
- [ ] Other

**Proposed Implementation / Architecture Details**
If you have ideas on schema, queries, dbt models, or code structure, describe them here.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions, tools, or workarounds you've evaluated.

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or reference links here.
